sample-revenue.speaker: Main Host
sample-revenue.text: First, Aster Works reports quarterly revenue growth. Markets Specialist, why do the figures differ?

sample-revenue.speaker: Markets Specialist
sample-revenue.text: Sample Markets puts growth at eight percent for continuing operations. The German report gives six percent across all operations. These figures cover different parts of the business.

sample-revenue.speaker: Main Host
sample-revenue.text: Economy Specialist, do the reports agree when they cover the same operations?

sample-revenue.speaker: Economy Specialist
sample-revenue.text: No. For all operations, the Dutch report estimates seven percent, while the German report gives six. The available reports leave that difference unresolved.

sample-rates.speaker: Main Host
sample-rates.text: Now to the Aster Reserve decision. Economy Specialist, what did the reserve decide?

sample-rates.speaker: Economy Specialist
sample-rates.text: The reserve held its policy rate at three percent. Both the English and Dutch reports give the same rate.
